item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We know the off switch is no safeguard: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We must act before that threshold—not after.

2. We reject “build it now, control it later.” If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We cannot treat an irreversible decision as a trial run.

3. We have to get this right before launch. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We demand that prevention—not promises of an off switch—guide our choices.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We stand for a simple principle: we must not surrender control over our future. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We cannot count on an emergency stop, a last-minute intervention, or a promise that control will come later. We must make the decisive choices before launch. That means demanding enforceable limits, public accountability, and the political will to stop development before we cross that threshold. We refuse to confuse the ability to build something with the right to unleash it. We have a responsibility to act now.
